name: Tower crane
description: Static hammerhead tower crane, about 37 m to the tower head: a cast base with a cruciform steel base frame and stacked concrete ballast blocks, a 1.6 m square yellow lattice mast to 30 m with an internal ladder and rest platforms, a slewing ring and turntable, a glazed operator cab, an A-frame tower head with pendant ties, a 40 m triangular lattice jib with a trolley and hook block, a 13 m counter-jib with walkway, hoist winch and counterweights, red warning lights. Visual only above the base: the mast is the only collider (not climbable).
